title: Special Executive Programme In Performance Marketing In Search And Social
description: The course aims to equip learners with essential knowledge and skills in performance marketing, specifically focusing on search engines and social media platforms.
longDescription: This course introduces performance marketing in digital landscapes, focusing on search engine marketing (SEM) and social media advertising. It explores strategies to optimize campaigns, track performance, and improve ROI using various tools and best practices.
courseDetails: Comprehend the fundamentals of Search Engine Marketing (SEM). Gain insight into the functionalities of major search engines like Google and Bing. Master keyword research and selection techniques for targeted campaigns. Develop proficiency in crafting impactful ad campaigns utilizing Google Ads. Hone skills in ad copywriting and conducting A/B testing for optimization. Implement strategies to improve Quality Score and Ad Rank. Learn effective budgeting and bidding strategies for SEM campaigns. Utilize tools and techniques to track and measure the performance of SEM initiatives. Introduction to social media advertising. Choosing the right social media platforms (Facebook, Instagram, Twitter, LinkedIn, etc.) Target audience segmentation and persona development. Integration of SEM and social media into a cohesive marketing strategy. Tracking and analytics tools (Google Analytics, Facebook Pixel). Performance marketing case studies and best practices. Staying updated with industry trends. Students will gain a solid foundation in performance marketing, covering search engine functionalities, ad campaign creation, keyword research, social media targeting, and audience segmentation. The course also delves into metrics, KPIs, and optimization strategies, helping learners create integrated SEM and social media marketing plans. Practical skills in budgeting, bidding, ad testing, and performance tracking will be developed. After the successful completion of this course, you will understand the following; Introduction to Performance Marketing Search Engine Marketing Essentials Social Media Advertising Performance Marketing Strategies and Optimisation
